hypothesis: The precommitted fixed63/98 equal-probability four-leaf component may improve the complete agent after search/confirmation/refit while smoothing supported-class losses, despite its extra fitting cost. Saved-probability evidence alone is insufficient.

control_historical.hypothesis: Fixed equal-weight original and cross-fitted categorical feature views; compare full procedure

support-proposal.hypothesis: Increasing LightGBM capacity from num_leaves=63 to num_leaves=98 will improve rare-class F1 (specifically Analysis and Backdoor) by allowing the model to capture more complex decision boundaries, while maintaining regularization to prevent overfitting on majority classes. This targets the measured low F1 for Analysis (0.326) and Backdoor (0.226) in the best recipe.

exact_fixed_component.fitting_scopes: Regenerate original/cross-fitted categorical views separately for each inner/outer/full fitting scope; preserve existing class weighting, calibration, parent rows and class order.

primary_design.A_control: Exact88dac current default offline complete agent, expected to reproduce known V11/V16 route. A is rerun on the same host; historical score alone is not the matched control.
primary_design.B_candidate: A differing only by availability of the one exact fixed four-leaf component at the final search slot; bounded internal feature-view support is necessary implementation, not a new ML factor.
primary_design.B_slot11: Exact frozen fixed63/98 component, replacing that fallback; no extra search slot or fit clock is appended.
primary_design.prior_slots0_through10: Require recipe/order/split/prediction/metric parity; fixed component is not eligible as an earlier fallback incumbent.
primary_design.B_default_entrypoint_requirement: The candidate archive exposes this deterministic eligible-task behavior through ordinary solution.py. Qualification may not use a hand-edited job, precomputed NPZ, root-only dispatcher or an extra opt-in flag absent from the default entrypoint.
primary_design.eligibility: Existing schema-based nontext MacroF1 classification eligibility with at least two declared categorical features; no public column/task/class-name conditions in runtime. Unsupported tasks retain A behavior.
primary_design.early_budget_exhaustion: If the component slot is not reached, preserve it as not_attempted; no late append/restart and no mechanism qualification.
primary_design.same_global_blend_selection: Retain existing agent global blend configurations/selection unchanged. Internal four-leaf weights remain fixed; outer agent blend weights are the existing selection procedure. If B selects a global blend, report its full final recipe tree.
primary_design.reason: This primary test matches the qualified offline V11/V16 default. Live Qwen/four-stage or HPO-on changes are separate factors and cannot be claimed from this test.

global ensemble workers reject explicit nested ensemble children.
current feature-view validation and refit iteration tree require exactly two leaves.
integration_contract_requirements.proposed_minimal_trusted_route: Versioned bounded four-leaf feature-view subtype retaining external engine=lightgbm and exact fixed leaf factory. This keeps ordinary global ensembles flat at their public recipe level. Internal fixed-four dispatch must be explicit; ordinary global ensemble2..3 contract is not silently widened.

prospective_resource_envelope.scope: Conservative maximum reservations, not ETA or authorization; actual procedures may finish sooner. No deadline assigned now.
prospective_resource_envelope.clock_rule: Each stage receives its own predeclared root-assigned absolute and monotonic deadline only at a separately reviewed future stage launch after previous stage terminal cleanup. This is a prospective staged protocol, never a reset of an active stage or failed attempt. Preserve every original stage deadline on continuation.
prospective_resource_envelope.admission_rule: Before a paired fold/whole-agent stage arm, reserve all remaining full parent caps and final verification; never clip a paired arm or900/other inherited worker allocation. Recalculate remaining after I/O.
prospective_resource_envelope.budget_parity: Equal solver/worker/HPO/API/selection clocks in A/B. Extra four-leaf cost is paid by B within its same clock/slot budget; no transfer of unused A time.
prospective_resource_envelope.future_caps_change: Any shorter envelope must be justified and frozen prospectively for both arms before outcome observation; cannot silently alter this card after scoring.

quality_and_lifecycle_gates.partitions: Exact current grouped splits; independently reconstruct from pristine raw fitting features and compare saved arrays. Do not change groups/split order or drop a cut.
quality_and_lifecycle_gates.primary_comparison: B complete-agent selected primary and confirmation vs actual matched A complete-agent selected primary and confirmation; mean of the two original per-cut MacroF1 scores reported separately.
quality_and_lifecycle_gates.historical_reference_floor: Also compare B with the known V11/V16 per-cut .6632403174648631/.6553953692580672 and mean .6593178433614652; a gain only against a degraded unmatched control is insufficient.
quality_and_lifecycle_gates.excluded_class_definition: Freeze least-supported raw-feature fitting class before scoring, Worms on these cuts; report mean original remaining class F1 with every validation row retained. Runtime must not hardcode that label.
quality_and_lifecycle_gates.control_parity: Verify A against V11/V16 report/recipes/iteration trees and CSV reference; unexplained divergence prevents a historical-comparability claim. Preserve actual matched results and diagnose rather than substitute the historical number.
quality_and_lifecycle_gates.verify_final_csv: Schema/rows/nonmissing/sample IDs/order/classes; saved test probability mixture reproduces CSV argmax; four leaf hashes/iterations/class order trace to actual fresh full fits.
quality_and_lifecycle_gates.if_component_not_selected: Do not claim fixed-component default improvement. Retain full-agent outcome and selection reason; no forced winner or manual final recipe replacement.
quality_and_lifecycle_gates.failures: Timeout, missing cut/refit/CSV, incomplete API/resource/source/cleanup evidence or nonnumeric/invalid probabilities are null/failed; no zero substitution, drop, retry or budget extension.
quality_and_lifecycle_gates.cost_report: Whole-agent wall/RSS, completed experiment/family/HPO counts, full learner-fit count not worker-call count, confirmations/full-refit cost and failed/not_attempted work.
quality_and_lifecycle_gates.regression_after_class_CV: In Stage2, both unchanged-default regression paths must complete/refit/export; candidate should reproduce control and known V11/V16 regression behavior. Any unexplained regression-path change blocks release, even if class metrics improve.

secondary_future_live_study: Only after a valid matched offline test, freeze a distinct matched live Qwen/four-stage/HPO-on protocol with equal planner/gateway/reasoning/Optuna clocks and budgets. It must independently prove pre-fit EDA, actual broad/selector/model/HPO stages, both cuts/refit/CSV. This card grants no such launch.

supersedes_draft.reason: Mandatory >=3fold grouped CV of entire selection procedure before public full-agent qualification; explicit staged resource envelopes.

execution_order: Stage0: isolated default-OFF backend/source/mocked-regression contract gates; no public fitting
Stage1: >=3 outer grouped folds, rerun entire offline A/B selection procedure independently per fold
Stage2: only after Stage1 passes, public two-cut whole-agent A/B with fresh full refits/CSV plus actual regression parity and final release verification

whole_selection_grouped_CV.algorithm: Frozen existing make_folds(spec,train,raw_feature_hashes,3,83), stratified by targets and grouped by pristine raw feature hashes; refuse if valid class/group-disjoint folds cannot be formed.
whole_selection_grouped_CV.outer_assignment: Every original training row is outer validation exactly once; no duplicate feature group crosses fitting/validation in any fold. No folds are omitted or retried.
whole_selection_grouped_CV.fit_entire_procedure: Each outer fitting partition is a new task with its own internal search/confirmation/grouped splits. Rerun all12 search slots, fallback selection, calibration, global blend selection and fresh refit on that outer fitting partition. Score only the resulting held-out outer predictions. No CV solely of the already chosen63/98 recipe.
whole_selection_grouped_CV.outer_labels_boundary: Fold assignment may stratify on labels. Outer validation targets remain only in the independent verifier; agent train contains outer-fitting labels and its test contains outer-validation features without labels. Seal predictions/source/selected recipe before verifier reads outer truth. Do not feed outer scores into that fold agent.
whole_selection_grouped_CV.resource_parity: Both arms use the same9900-second solver clock,12 slots,0HPO/0API,threads2/worker1.5GiB/whole2GiB and identical validation/model/selection defaults. No saved fitted model reuse, cache, best-recipe injection or budget transfer.
metrics: Per-fold complete-agent MacroF1 and original per-class F1
Arithmetic mean of the three outer-fold MacroF1 scores
Pooled MacroF1 from exactly-once out-of-fold predictions, explicitly distinct from fold mean
Per-fold fitting independent feature-group support, excluded least-supported fitting class, ex-rarest F1 and supported-class deltas
Wall time/RSS, all actual learner fits, failed/not-attempted work and refit/CSV status
whole_selection_grouped_CV.failure_action: Keep all folds/null failures and stop before Stage2; no alpha/capacity/threshold tuning, reseeding or post-score gate relaxation. Record negative/uncertain result.
whole_selection_grouped_CV.evidence_limit: Even nested development folds follow an adaptive reused-public hypothesis; do not label them private/official or statistically independent of the research history.

prototype_before_integration.tree: New isolated development copy only, separate from selector-cache and HPO trees
prototype_before_integration.default: OFF; implement and mock-check only bounded four-leaf backend/iteration/calibration/contracts first
prototype_before_integration.candidate_default_entrypoint_revision: Last-slot availability in ordinary default candidate archive is a later isolated reviewed change, frozen before Stage1. An explicit experimental flag is fine for source/mocked development, but cannot substitute for the eventual default entrypoint comparison.
prototype_before_integration.while_trueMVP_active: Only code preparation, AST/compile/mocked no-fit checks with one thread; no heavy fixture suites, public ML, API or guarded source/helper edits.

independent_narrow_amendment_review.scope: Methodology review of proposed amendment; not implementation or launch approval.

preconditions: This new r3 protocol must be reviewed and committed before any Stage1 CV fit.
No CV outcomes existed when this amendment was prepared. Preserve r2, frozen candidate hypothesis, all3 fold definitions and all original limits/gates/source factors.
All original before-fit technical, source, lifecycle and root-authorization requirements remain binding.
pre_fit_fail_fast_amendment.scope: Stage1 grouped whole-selection CV only. This is a deterministic failure-only shortcut for an already impossible all-fold qualification, not a positive sequential test.
pre_fit_fail_fast_amendment.unchanged_fields: Every r2 protocol field/value is inherited unchanged except protocol_id; this additional amendment clarifies failure execution/reporting only. Fold splits, gates, metrics, capacities, weights, arm caps, stage reservations and Stage2 prerequisites are unchanged.

quality_rejection_rule.timing: Evaluate only after BOTH arms of the current fold have completed the entire selection/refit procedure and sealed their predictions, final CSV, selected recipe/iteration tree and source/input/artifact hashes. Independently audit the sealed pair against pristine verifier-only outer labels and frozen fold/support definitions.
quality_rejection_rule.no_feedback: Do not reveal A outer metrics, labels or per-class feedback to B before its predictions are sealed, or reveal any fold score to an uncompleted later arm. No agent may see the independent outer audit.
irreversible_triggers: Current-fold candidate MacroF1 delta fails the existing strict-positive gate.
Current-fold candidate ex-rarest MacroF1 delta fails the existing strict-positive gate.
Any current-fold supported-class delta fails the existing minimum -0.01 gate using the existing >=100 independent fitting-group support definition.
quality_rejection_rule.comparators: Use the unchanged r2 metrics, excluded-class/support definitions and comparators; no new tolerance, threshold, class exclusion or outcome-dependent rule.
quality_rejection_rule.invalid_metrics: Nonnumeric, nonfinite, missing or invalid predictions/metrics are completion/integrity failures, not evidence that a finite candidate quality delta is inferior.
quality_rejection_rule.proof: A valid independent audit must identify the irreversible violated gate and bind the decisive sealed A/B artifacts, pristine inputs and exact fold arrays by SHA256 before the stop is accepted.

technical_rejection_rule.timing: A demonstrable violation of any existing mandatory completion/integrity/resource/source requirement makes all-three-complete qualification impossible and may reject before the other arm or later folds are attempted.
technical_rejection_rule.cleanup: Stop admitting work immediately. Finish fail-closed owned-process cleanup and independently verify the exact PID/create_time identities and descendants before declaring terminal/releasing the central lock. Cleanup uncertainty remains a fatal blocker, never permission to start another job.
technical_rejection_rule.interpretation: Keep technical_failure distinct from quality_gate_failure. A technically invalid/incomplete run does not establish inferior ML quality.

not_quality_rejection_triggers: Running fold mean, provisional pooled/OOF score or projection of future quality.
The fixed component not being reached or selected in only one fold; the original somewhere mechanism condition is evaluated at its original complete-matrix scope.
A local unused budget or a projected cost/timeout; only an actual inherited completion/admission failure may reject technically.
Outcome-dependent reseeding, fold replacement, arm order change, extra candidate or a newly invented confidence/plateau test.

partial_rejection_reporting.matrix_rule: Keep all3 declared folds and every one of the6 arm slots in the result manifest in their frozen order, with unchanged split hashes. A not-attempted slot is present, not dropped.

unattempted_arm_record.reason: Reference the decisive prior sealed audit and violated gate; no execution is implied.

partial_rejection_reporting.estimation_forbidden: Do not impute zero, substitute a historical/control score, omit missing arms, estimate unobserved outcomes, present a partial subset as full-CV fold mean/pooled/OOF, or claim complete CV. Valid observed individual-fold results may be reported with their restricted scope.
partial_rejection_reporting.actual_work: Report all actual completed/failed/not-attempted arms, observed costs and the technical-versus-quality stop reason. Unspent reservation is not a measured ML gain or an estimate of saved execution time.

pre_fit_fail_fast_amendment.positive_qualification: Unchanged: ALL3 paired folds/ALL6 arms must complete validly, with actual exactly-once outer coverage and group disjointness, every original per-fold quality/support gate, valid full-fold mean and pooled gates, original mechanism requirements and all lifecycle evidence. Partial results can never pass or promote.
after_rejection: Do not retry, replace/reseed a fold or candidate, relax a gate, reset/extend any clock, or transfer unused A/B time.
Do not reinvest saved time into additional arms or candidates of this comparison. Preserve the failed attempt; any future different hypothesis requires a separate prospective reviewed protocol.
pre_fit_fail_fast_amendment.resource_rule: All r2 stage/arm caps and conservative maximum reservations remain unchanged. Early rejection may consume less than that maximum but is not an ETA or a budget bonus; any future stage launch still needs a separately reviewed absolute deadline and predecessor cleanup.
